summary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, attaching an ASX announcement titled 'Commercial update on vitiligo.' The update reviews clinical benchmarks for SCENESSE (afamelanotide) versus NB-UVB phototherapy and JAK inhibitors for vitiligo, referencing trial results and standard of care. No transaction, offer, or special-situation event is involved; it is a routine commercial and clinical update by the issuer. The filing contains no deal terms, board actions, or strategic alternatives.
